description: Culp Farms is an independent pumpkin patch in 11602 County Road 51, AL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
